notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
CHANGES
- Coins now join together when they come in contact to a max value of ~$100
- Cursor can no longer leave the window if the game is active (doesn't happen in menus)

notes.title: Small Update - Minimap
notes.notes:
CHANGES
- New ability: Boomerang
- Changed how projectile size is calculated, to allow smaller projectiles (e.g. minigun) to have a greater effect
- Minimap: Press tab to toggle the minimap - Replacement for chest arrows to reduce visual clutter
